title: You Can Add Thousands of Online Friends, Yet Your Brain Caps Real Ties Near One Fifty
description:
You think social apps gave humans limitless real friendship circles! Yet ancient biology still caps every genuine circle tightly! This is the true story of Robin Dunbar's Social Brain Discovery. Here is what went wrong with the jungle fruit myth.
